# Changelog for huawei-cloud-ecs-passwordless-login v1.0.2

- Added full support for batch passwordless login: deploy SSH keys across multiple ECS instances in one workflow.
- Now uses Ed25519 SSH keys exclusively; RSA/ECDSA/DSA are no longer supported.
- Improved COC target resolution: instances can be specified by instance ID or EIP, and actual regions are dynamically resolved.
- COC and IAM API calls use the global region model (cn-north-4 or ap-southeast-3); documentation clarifies this.
- Workflow and command instructions updated for batch operation and multi-region awareness.
- Minor documentation refinements; removed obsolete files.

- Automates 7-step workflow for setting up passwordless SSH login to Huawei Cloud ECS via COC, including IAM role binding, key generation, script deployment, SSH verification, ControlMaster setup, and auto-cleanup.
- Skips IAM agency/role setup if agency already exists (idempotent authorization).
- Ensures private SSH keys are never exposed, logged, or persisted longer than necessary; mandatory cleanup runs after 60 seconds.
- SSH ControlMaster is used for session persistence even after key removal — cleanup only blocks new connections.
- Includes fallback cleanup via COC if remote removal fails.
- Provides clear and reusable core commands and prerequisites.
